Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: PvP cues, Smart Tab, responsive helpers, and survival tools.
Description: A local PvP HUD with searchable CC player rankings and prediction, nameplate cues, Limit Break alerts, pressure and CC information, Ping Helpers, medicine-kit beacons, range rings, a Wolves' Den map panel, recovery and job helpers, Smart Tab, assist macros, MP sounds, and target highlights.
Changelog: Added /seitonsam: a SAM-only 5-yalm Smart Action target helper that needs no selected target in CC and uses exact <t> in enabled Wolves' Den testing. Own Kuzushi or Debana and Stun are preferred. Ogi Namikiri and Tendo Setsugekka started by /seitonsam are protected from ordinary movement and helper cancellation while Purify and manual Guard remain available.
